UI.Health_Fix_Confirm: Run the administrator-configured repair for {0}? It may close applications or interrupt services or networking. Save your work first. The status will be checked again afterwards.
UI.Health_Restart_Confirm:
Windows will restart to complete the pending updates and changes.
Save your work and close all programs first. The restart begins about 30 seconds after you confirm.
Restart now?
UI.Health_Restart_Started: Windows restarts in about 30 seconds. Save your work now.
UI.Health_Updates_Started: Windows updates are being searched, downloaded and installed. This can take several minutes; you can keep working.
UI.Health_Updates_Done: Windows Update has finished. The device status is checked again and shows whether a restart is needed.
UI.Health_Apps_Started: The installation of the failed apps starts again. This can take a few minutes; you can follow it in the Company Portal.
UI.Subtitle_Text: You may find a way to solve it here with a list of clickable solutions
UI.Theme_Button_ToolTip: Switch between dark and light theme
UI.Shield_ToolTip: Runs with administrator rights through the local SelfX service
UI.Solution_Mode_Info_Text:
The simplified view lists issues by product. The detailed view lists several specific issues per product that can be solved.
We recommend the detailed view if the simplified view does not solve or include your issue.
UI.Reboot_Alert: To keep your device stable and working properly, restart it at least once a week.
UI.Service_Running_Text: The SelfX service is running: actions marked with a shield run with administrator rights.
UI.Service_Unavailable_Text: The SelfX service is not running: actions marked with a shield are not available.
UI.Service_Busy_Text: Another action is still running. Please wait until it is finished.
UI.Action_Timeout_Text: Action stopped because it took too long: {0}
UI.Script_Not_Found_Text: The script of this action was not found: {0}
UI.SystemInfo_Title_Text: Information about your device for the support team
UI.SystemInfo_Hint_Text: Double-click a line to copy its value.
UI.Report_Mail_Body:
Hello,
Please find attached the device logs of {0}, collected by SelfX on {1}.
Description of the issue:
UI.Report_Mail_Opened_Text: An e-mail with the device logs attached has been opened. Describe your issue and send the e-mail.
UI.Report_Mail_Recipient_Text: An e-mail with the device logs attached has been opened. Enter the recipient ({0}), describe your issue and send the e-mail.
UI.Report_Mail_Manual_Text: The device logs have been saved to {0}. Attach this file to an e-mail (recipient: {1}) and describe your issue.
UI.Report_Not_Found_Text: The device logs were collected, but the e-mail could not be prepared: {0}
UI.Status_NotChecked_Text: The device status has not been checked yet.
UI.Status_Background_Battery_Text: Automatic checks are paused while the device runs on battery
UI.Status_Checking_Text: Checking the device status. This can take up to a minute ...
UI.Status_AllOk_Text: No problems were found on your device.
UI.Status_Issues_Text: Problems are shown first. Click “Fix” to repair a problem, or the arrow button to check it again.
UI.Status_CheckAll_Tooltip: Check everything again now. This can take up to a minute.
UI.Status_FixAll_Tooltip: Run the configured repair for every problem, one after another. Everything is checked again afterwards.
UI.Status_FixAll_Done: {0} of {1} repairs completed successfully. The status is being checked again.
UI.Tooltip_Fix: Repairs this problem automatically. You are asked to confirm first.
UI.Tooltip_Run: Starts this solution. You are asked to confirm before anything happens.
UI.View_Help_Tooltip: What is the difference between the simplified and the detailed view?
UI.Tooltip_Copy: copies all information, for example to paste it into a support request
UI.Tooltip_Export: saves all information as a file
UI.Tooltip_SyncApps: Asks Intune to install or update the apps assigned to you now.
UI.Tooltip_SyncCompliance: Asks Intune to check now whether your device meets the company rules.
UI.Tooltip_CompanyPortal: Opens the Company Portal, where you can install company apps.
UI.Tooltip_QuickAssist: Opens Quick Assist so that a support person can see your screen and help you – only with your consent.
UI.Tooltip_MdmDiagnostics: Collects the device management logs into a folder for the support team.
UI.Tooltip_SendLogs: Collects all logs of your device and opens an e-mail to the support team with the report attached.
UI.Settings_Language_Hint: SelfX restarts in the selected language.
UI.Settings_Language_Later: The new language is used the next time SelfX is opened, because a repair is still running.
UI.Settings_Theme_Auto_ToolTip: As Windows: uses the app mode chosen in Settings > Personalization > Colors
UI.Settings_Tray_Text: Show the SelfX icon in the notification area
UI.Settings_Tray_Hint: The icon next to the clock shows the device status and informs you when a problem is found.
UI.Settings_Notify_Hint: In addition to the colored SelfX icon, Windows shows a message when a new problem is found, for example low disk space.
UI.Support_Intro_Text: We are happy to help you. You can reach us as follows:
UI.Support_None_Text: No contact details have been configured. Please contact your IT department.
